Make planning a Ghanaian wedding simple, transparent and joyful, for every couple and every budget.
Add a short introduction here: where you're from, your background, and what Ghanaian weddings mean to you.

Planning a wedding in Ghana means planning two celebrations: the traditional engagement and the white wedding. Couples juggle the engagement list, vendors found through friends of friends, prices that change with every phone call, and guest lists spread across WhatsApp groups.

We built AfroVows to bring all of that into one place. Anyone can browse a free directory of checked vendors with clear prices in cedis, and couples get private tools to plan with their partner and family, so they spend less time chasing details and more time celebrating.
Two ceremonies, prices in cedis, Mobile Money and WhatsApp, the way weddings really happen here.
